title: The IPv6 Black Hole: Why your website works on your phone but Googlebot sees it as offline
body:
Are you suffering a catastrophic drop in Google traffic while your website loads perfectly when you visit it from your device?

For a freelancer or small business, losing search rankings means the phone stops ringing and quote requests freeze completely. Many entrepreneurs spend their budget on copywriters and links, unaware that an invisible network configuration failure in their own server is blocking the search engine, silently destroying the business viability.

The trap of automated DNS configuration

When hiring a typical hosting plan or activating an automated CDN provider, it is frequent that an AAAA record for IPv6 networks is created by default. The big problem is that Googlebot systematically prioritizes connections under the IPv6 protocol to crawl and index content; if your business server is misrouted or the firewall rejects these requests without alerting you, Google will determine that your site is down. Your business becomes invisible to Google even if you see it fully operational.

Our solution: Transactional IPv6 Routing Audit

At LANZA ESTUDIO we solve this bottleneck by reconfiguring your small business technological infrastructure to guarantee clean and predictable indexing.

  1. Network resolution diagnosis: We evaluate through custom scripts how your real hosting responds to Googlebot requests under IPv6.
  2. AAAA record debugging: We reconfigure the DNS zones to align the protocol directive with the open server ports.
  3. Connectivity rules adjustment: We optimize the firewall to allow traffic from official Google ranges without compromising internal security.
  4. Verification and forced reindexing: We execute direct requests from Search Console to validate that definitive access is error-free.

The Real Impact on Your Results

  • Recovery of strategic rankings: Your small business appears again before your potential clients in less than 48 hours.
  • Maximum crawl efficiency: We ensure Google processes every page of your service catalog smoothly and without interruptions.
  • Customer flow protection: We ensure entrepreneurs receive their web conversions without invisible technological losses.
